messages.intro: Browse every date filter below. Enabled filters appear in compatible search fields; disabled filters are hidden from new selections.
messages.availability: Some choices apply only to timed fields. Existing applied or saved filters keep working even if disabled. Other signed-in sessions need to reload after an administrator changes availability.

filterSummaries.ever: No date restriction. Always available so you can clear a filter.
filterSummaries.past: Dates before today; for timed values, up to and including now (Espo’s built-in rule).
filterSummaries.future: Dates after today; for timed values, after now (Espo’s built-in rule).
filterSummaries.todayPastExt: From midnight today up to now, excluding now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.todayFutureExt: From now up to midnight tomorrow, including now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.lastSevenDays: From midnight 7 days ago through today; for timed values, ends at now.
filterSummaries.lastSevenDaysExt: The previous 7 whole days, ending before today starts.
filterSummaries.lastXDays: From midnight X days ago through today; for timed values, ends at now.
filterSummaries.lastXDaysExt: The previous X whole days, ending before today starts.
filterSummaries.nextXDays: From today through the end of the day X days ahead; for timed values, starts at now.
filterSummaries.nextXDaysExt: X whole days starting tomorrow. Excludes today.
filterSummaries.olderThanXDays: Before midnight X days ago, with no lower limit.
filterSummaries.afterXDays: From midnight X days ahead onward, including that midnight.
filterSummaries.upToNextXWeeksExt: All history up to the end of the next X complete weeks. X=0 ends at the end of this week; the cutoff is excluded.
filterSummaries.upToNextXWeeksFutureExt: From now to the end of the next X complete weeks. X=0 ends at the end of this week; the cutoff is excluded.
filterSummaries.afterNextXWeeksExt: From the end of the next X complete weeks onward, including the cutoff. X=0 starts at the end of this week.
filterSummaries.afterXWeeksAgoExt: From the end of the week X weeks ago onward, including future values. X=1 starts at this week’s start; X=0 at this week’s end.
filterSummaries.afterXWeeksAgoPastExt: From the end of the week X weeks ago up to now, excluding now. X=1 starts at this week’s start. X must be at least 1.
filterSummaries.beforeXWeeksAgoExt: Before the start of the week X weeks ago, with no lower limit. X=0 uses this week’s start. The cutoff is excluded.
filterSummaries.isEmpty: Records whose selected date field has no value.
filterSummaries.on: The calendar date you enter, including all times on that date.
filterSummaries.after: After the date you enter; excludes that calendar date.
filterSummaries.before: Before the date you enter; excludes that calendar date.
filterSummaries.between: Between the two dates you enter, including both calendar dates.
filterSummaries.currentMinuteExt: The whole current minute, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentMinutePastExt: From the start of this minute up to now, excluding now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.currentMinuteFutureExt: From now to the end of this minute, including now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.lastXMinutesExt: The previous X complete minutes. Excludes the current minute.
filterSummaries.nextXMinutesExt: The next X complete minutes, starting at the next minute boundary.
filterSummaries.currentHourExt: The whole current hour, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentHourPastExt: From the start of this hour up to now, excluding now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.currentHourFutureExt: From now to the end of this hour, including now. Timed values only.
filterSummaries.lastXHoursExt: The previous X complete hours. Excludes the current hour.
filterSummaries.nextXHoursExt: The next X complete hours, starting at the next hour boundary.
filterSummaries.currentWeekExt: The whole current week, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentWeekPastExt: From the start of this week up to now, excluding now. On date-only fields, today is excluded.
filterSummaries.currentWeekFutureExt: From now to the end of this week, including now. On date-only fields, today is included.
filterSummaries.lastXWeeksExt: The previous X complete weeks. Excludes the current week.
filterSummaries.nextXWeeksExt: The next X complete weeks, starting at the next week boundary.
filterSummaries.currentMonth: The whole current month, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentMonthPastExt: From the start of this month up to now, excluding now. On date-only fields, today is excluded.
filterSummaries.currentMonthFutureExt: From now to the end of this month, including now. On date-only fields, today is included.
filterSummaries.lastXMonthsExt: The previous X complete months. Excludes the current month.
filterSummaries.nextXMonthsExt: The next X complete months, starting at the next month boundary.
filterSummaries.currentQuarter: The whole current quarter, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentQuarterPastExt: From the start of this quarter up to now, excluding now. On date-only fields, today is excluded.
filterSummaries.currentQuarterFutureExt: From now to the end of this quarter, including now. On date-only fields, today is included.
filterSummaries.lastXQuartersExt: The previous X complete quarters. Excludes the current quarter.
filterSummaries.nextXQuartersExt: The next X complete quarters, starting at the next quarter boundary.
filterSummaries.currentYear: The whole current year, including its past and future parts.
filterSummaries.currentYearPastExt: From the start of this year up to now, excluding now. On date-only fields, today is excluded.
filterSummaries.currentYearFutureExt: From now to the end of this year, including now. On date-only fields, today is included.
filterSummaries.lastXYearsExt: The previous X complete years. Excludes the current year.
filterSummaries.nextXYearsExt: The next X complete years, starting at the next year boundary.
filterSummaries.currentFiscalQuarter: The whole current fiscal quarter, using the application’s fiscal-year settings.
filterSummaries.lastFiscalQuarter: The whole previous fiscal quarter, using the application’s fiscal-year settings.
filterSummaries.currentFiscalYear: The whole current fiscal year, using the application’s fiscal-year settings.
filterSummaries.lastFiscalYear: The whole previous fiscal year, using the application’s fiscal-year settings.

periods.title: Complete periods
items: `Last X` / `Next X` selects X whole periods and excludes the current one.
Last periods end at the start of the current period. Next periods start at the next period boundary.
periods.example: At 12:22, `Last X Hours` with X=3 selects 09:00–12:00. `Next X Hours` selects 13:00–16:00.

boundaries.title: Start and end boundaries
items: Extension ranges include their start and exclude their end.
Relative ranges recalculate each time you search, including saved searches.
boundaries.example: A range from midnight September 8 up to midnight September 9 includes September 8, but not September 9.

count.title: Choosing X
items: X is a whole number. Extension filters accept 1–10,000.
The five week cutoffs whose summaries above describe X=0 also accept zero.
Built-in Espo filters retain their own validation.

calendar.title: Weeks, quarters, and fiscal periods
items: Weeks follow the application’s configured week start.
Calendar quarters are January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December.
Fiscal filters use the application’s fiscal-year settings.

dates.title: Date-only and all-day values
items: Date-only fields have no time of day. Their current-period `(Past)` filters exclude today; `(Future)` filters include today.
Minute/hour filters exclude all-day Tasks and Meetings.

zone.title: Timezones and clock changes
items: Datetime ranges use the search timezone, falling back to the application timezone.
Calendar days follow daylight-saving changes and include leap days.

field.title: Which field is compared?
items: Each filter compares the selected field, including related date fields.
Empty dates do not match a date range. Use `Is Empty` to find them.
field.example: `Date Start` = `Today` does not match a meeting that started yesterday and continues today. `Date End` is a separate field.
